messages:
incident-bot: Severity 2 - elevated error rate detected for /v1/generate across us-east-1. Auto-paging to oncall (Priya). Details: 5xx spike, spikes in token latencies. Docs: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2351234567 :warning:
Priya: On it. I'm pulling logs and checking autoscaler history. Paging Alex (SRE) and Jonah (Platform) to join bridge.
Alex: Joining bridge now. saw a sudden increase in GPU OOM retries on l2-prod-pool-3 around 12:03 UTC, causing queued requests and timeouts.
Jonah: I can see a routing surge from hosted-api-router-2 -> l2-prod-pool-3. Possible hot-shard after a model rollout? Checking model-version headers.
Mei: Support seeing customer reports — a few timeouts and partial responses. Flagging top 3 affected customers, will prepare a short impact note.
Claire: Please add customer-facing line for status page that we're investigating increased errors for text generation. No PII in the note.
Priya: Mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic off l2-prod-pool-3 to l2-prod-pool-1/2, 2) scale up burst capacity + enable degraded-mode fallback (smaller model variant) for non-enterprise tenants, 3) kick KV cache warming on warm pool. Implementing now.
Jonah: Routing rule applied: drained l2-prod-pool-3. Confirming active connections shifting.
Alex: Hotfix: rolled back last kernel change on l2-prod-pool-3 and restarted workers. For safety, kept pool drained while we observe.
incident-bot: Action logged: incident-2351234567 created. Bridge link: https://zoom.redwood.ai/bridge/2351234567.
Mei: Customer impact quick summary (internal): ~0.8% of requests in window failed with 504/502, increased p95 latency from 220ms -> 1.2s, spike lasted ~18m before mitigation. Top 3 customers accounted for ~60% of affected requests.
Claire: Draft status page update ready: "We experienced elevated errors for text generation in us-east-1 between 12:02–12:20 UTC. Services are recovered. We’re investigating root cause and will share an RCA." Want ops approval before posting.
Priya: Approved. Post status update and ping customers in the affected list with the short notice and offer bridge if they want more detail.
Alex: Observing decreased error rate now, p95 back near baseline. Keeping monitoring for 30m. Initial hypothesis: a kernel memory regression + a routing imbalance combined with a traffic spike.
Jonah: Adding to timeline: 11:59 UTC - small model kernel rollout to l2-prod-pool-3; 12:02 - error spike; 12:04 - auto-drain triggered; 12:06 - manual drain + rollback; 12:20 - error rates normalized.
Mei: Sent proactive DMs to affected customers with the status page link and offer to join a follow-up RCA call. Two asked for a technical rundown.
Priya: Great. Next steps: schedule postmortem, define action items, assign owners, and prepare customer RCA deliverable. Propose 2-hour postmortem slot tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
Alex: I can own the technical postmortem write-up (root cause, rollout diffs, telemetry). Estimate 3-4 hours.
Jonah: I'll handle routing and autoscaler playbook updates. Also will capture the kernel rollout gating steps that failed.
Claire: I'll draft the customer RCA summary and coordinate exec brief. Prefer to have a dry-run before sending to large customers.
Mei: I'll attach the customer impact logs and the list of affected request IDs. Also add notes from the support tickets.
Priya: Action items (quick):
- A1: Root-cause analysis + diff of rollout -> Alex -> due in 48h.
- A2: Autoscaler/runbook updates for drain detection -> Jonah -> due in 72h.
- A3: Customer RCA draft & exec brief -> Claire -> due in 24h (first draft).
- A4: Ticket consolidations and customer DMs follow-up -> Mei -> due EOD today.
- A5: Add automated alert for kernel memory regression (new metric) -> Sam -> due 72h.
Sam: I will add the alert and a Grafana dashboard panel. Will PR the alert today.
Alex: Temporary mitigations to keep: keep l2-prod-pool-3 drained until we run a controlled kernel canary with traffic shaping.
Jonah: Scheduling controlled canary: will reserve 10% traffic window, and add circuit-breaker threshold at 2x baseline latency.
Priya: Postmortem scheduling: tomorrow 15:00 UTC, 2 hours. If that works for authors, I'll create the calendar invite and post the draft agenda here.
Alex: Works for me.
Jonah: Works.
Claire: Works.
Mei: Works.
Priya: Draft agenda:
- Timeline & impact recap (10m)
- Technical root cause walkthrough (30m)
- Detection & mitigation timeline (20m)
- Action items & owners (15m)
- Customer comm plan & exec brief (25m)
- AOB (10m)
Priya: Also note: customer-facing artifact checklist: status page entry, concise RCA (1 pager), detailed technical appendix (for customers with NDAs), and a postmortem blog for internal/external as appropriate.
Claire: I'll aim for a 1-page RCA for customers and attach the appendix for those who request it under an NDA. Draft will be posted to #incidents-drafts and shared here for review.
Mei: For the affected customers who asked for bridge, I'm proposing two sessions: one technical (deep dive) and one exec (impact & SLAs). Any objections?
Priya: Sounds good. Keep exec sessions short (15–20m). Alex/Jonah can join technical session.
Sam: PR created for new alert: PR#482 — will link it in the postmortem doc.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: Postmortem meeting in 23 hours.
Priya: Closing notes: we restored service with drain + rollback + fallback. Root cause investigation in progress. Action owners assigned. Claire will begin customer comms draft and Mei will continue bridge offers. Thank you everyone for the quick response. :clap:
